entries.text: Query results record a fetch_mode (rows or arrow) per query and per run. DuckDB now receives results as Arrow inside the query timer and builds Python rows only for digests and validation; set the fetch_mode platform option to rows to switch back.
details: Full result receipt stays inside every query interval; Arrow-to-rows conversion is never timed.
Result comparison, regression detection and rankings work within one fetch mode only: mixed-mode comparisons are refused, and report rankings takes --fetch-mode.
